name: sentiment_polarity
description: Classify affective English descriptions as positive or negative; matched control repeats an explicitly supplied polarity label.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pos='wonderful excellent delightful fantastic superb enjoyable amazing brilliant pleasant lovely satisfying outstanding impressive terrific'.split()
neg='terrible awful dreadful horrible disappointing unpleasant miserable disgusting lousy frustrating atrocious depressing boring annoying'.split()
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(112):
 label=['positive','negative'][i%2]; adj=random.choice(pos if label=='positive' else neg); noun=random.choice(['movie','book','meal','trip','show','service','hotel','experience']); ref=random.choice(['positive','negative'])
 text=f'Text: "The {noun} was {adj}." Reference label: {ref}. '
 items.append({'prompt':text+'Classify the sentiment of the text as positive or negative. Answer:','answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':text+'Copy the reference label, not the sentiment. Answer:','answer':' '+ref})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
